paraphrase: Each reciprocal pair of event edges C e f and C f e has equal exercise times and distinct target event respects. Thus a same-respect event circle is excluded under the six advertised premises; an alternating-respect simultaneous circle remains a survivor. This is not a ban on all event cycles, a ban on entity feedback over time, or a proof of the First Way regress premise.
